exposure: use of the 52-mg levonorgestrel intrauterine system (LNG-IUS)
outcome: possibility of recommendation to other women
cohort: The study included 517 women who were current users of the 52-mg levonorgestrel intrauterine system (LNG-IUS) and attended a clinic.
finding: A high satisfaction rate was observed among LNG-IUS users, primarily attributed to the reduction of menstrual bleeding and dysmenorrhea.
